confirmation_note: Charlotte citations are managed via 'Park It'. Appeals MUST be submitted within 10 calendar days of issuance — one of the tightest windows in the country. If you miss the 10-day mark, the system locks the 'Appeal' button and automatically triggers a $25.00 late penalty on day 11. Using Certified Express for Charlotte is a strategic necessity to prove intent to appeal before the lockout. Note that Airport citations (CLT) use a separate review committee; this address is for City/On-street violations only.
